actions.create_business_profile.descript: Creates a new business profile in AiPrise. The returned profile can then be used to run document checks or other business verifications.
actions.create_business_profile.props.ad: A JSON array of supporting documents or extra data for this business.
A JSON array of address objects associated with the business.
actions.create_business_profile.props.al: An alternate "doing business as" name, if any.
actions.create_business_profile.props.bu: A government-issued entity identifier for this business.
actions.create_business_profile.props.ca: A webhook URL that AiPrise will call with verification results.
actions.create_business_profile.props.cl: Your own internal identifier for this business.
actions.create_business_profile.props.co: The 2-letter ISO country code where the business is registered (e.g. US, GB).
actions.create_business_profile.props.em: One or more email addresses associated with the business.
actions.create_business_profile.props.ev: A webhook URL that AiPrise will call with event notifications.
actions.create_business_profile.props.fo: The date the business was formed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
actions.create_business_profile.props.na: The business name. The legal name is preferred.
actions.create_business_profile.props.ph: One or more phone numbers associated with the business.
actions.create_business_profile.props.st: The state or province code where the business is registered (e.g. CA, NY).
actions.create_business_profile.props.ta: Tag names used to categorize this business profile.
The tax ID for this business (e.g. EIN in the US).
actions.create_user_profile.description: Creates a new user profile in AiPrise. The returned profile can then be used for repeated verifications or ongoing monitoring for the same person.
actions.create_user_profile.props.client: Your own internal identifier for this user.
actions.create_user_profile.props.date_o: User's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.
actions.create_user_profile.props.events: A webhook URL that AiPrise will call with event notifications for this profile. Paste the webhook URL from the **Verification Event Received** trigger here.
actions.create_user_profile.props.full_n: The complete name. Use this if you do not have the name split into parts.
actions.create_user_profile.props.second: User's second surname, where applicable (e.g. in some Latin American naming conventions).
actions.create_user_profile.props.tags.d: Tag names used to categorize this user profile. Tags are created if they do not already exist.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_additional_user_info.descrip: Fetches supplementary information collected from the person during a verification — anything beyond the primary identity fields, such as follow-up answers, extra documents, or custom form data.
actions.get_additional_user_info.props.s: The ID of the verification to look up. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action
actions.get_business_documents.descripti: Lists all documents attached to a business profile — including file UUIDs, names, S3 URLs, timestamps, document sources, and associated verification sessions.
actions.get_business_documents.props.bus: The ID of the business profile whose documents you want to list. You can get this from the output of the **Create Business Profile** action.
actions.get_business_input_data.descript: Returns the company information provided during a business verification — such as company name, registration number, directors, and ownership details.
actions.get_business_input_data.props.se: The ID of the business verification to retrieve data from. You can get this from the output of the **Start Business Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
actions.get_business_profile.description: Fetches a business profile from AiPrise by its ID — including the stored company details, addresses, tags, linked verification sessions, and metadata.
actions.get_business_profile.props.busin: The ID of the business profile to retrieve. You can get this from the output of the **Create Business Profile** action, or from the `business_profile_id` field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
actions.get_business_verification_result: Fetches the current status and outcome of a company's background check — whether it is still running, approved, or declined.
The ID of the business verification to look up. You can get this from the output of the **Start Business Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
actions.get_user_input_data.description: Returns the information the person entered and the documents they uploaded during their identity check (e.g. name, date of birth, ID document details).
actions.get_user_input_data.props.sessio: The ID of the verification to retrieve data from. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
actions.get_user_profile.description: Fetches a user profile from AiPrise by its ID — including the person's stored details, tags, linked verification sessions, and metadata.
actions.get_user_profile.props.user_prof: The ID of the user profile to retrieve. You can get this from the output of the **Create User Profile** action, or from the `user_profile_id` field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
actions.get_verification_result.descript: Fetches the current status and outcome of a person's identity check — whether it is still in progress, approved, or declined.
actions.get_verification_result.props.se: The ID of the specific verification to look up. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
actions.get_verification_url.description: Generates a secure link you can send to a person so they can complete their identity verification on an AiPrise-hosted page — no extra development needed.
actions.get_verification_url.props.redir: The page the person will be sent to after they finish the verification on the AiPrise-hosted form (e.g. a "Thank you" or confirmation page on your website).
actions.get_verification_url.props.templ: Which set of checks the person will go through. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.
actions.run_business_verification.descri: Kicks off a company background check. AiPrise will run the checks defined in your template — which can include company registry lookup, ownership structure (UBO), sanctions screening, and adverse media.
The ID of the business profile you want to verify. This is returned when you create a business profile, or you can look it up using the List Business Profiles action.
Which set of checks to run on the business. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.
actions.run_document_check.description: Runs a verification check on a document belonging to an existing business profile. AiPrise will process the uploaded file against the checks defined in the chosen template.
actions.run_document_check.props.busines: The ID of the business profile the document belongs to. You can find this in AiPrise → **Businesses** → open the business → copy the **Profile ID**.
actions.run_document_check.props.client_: Any additional JSON data you want to store alongside this request.
Your own identifier to associate with this request — for example an order number or internal case ID.
actions.run_document_check.props.documen: An optional unique identifier for this document input. This value is included in webhook payloads and API responses so you can distinguish between multiple documents.
actions.run_document_check.props.file_uu: The UUID of the document file that was previously uploaded to AiPrise.
actions.run_document_check.props.templat: Which set of checks to run. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.
actions.run_user_verification_profile.de: Kicks off a new identity check for a person. AiPrise will run the checks defined in your chosen template (e.g. ID document scan, liveness, address).
actions.run_user_verification_profile.pr: Which set of checks to run. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.
Your own identifier for this person — for example their user ID, email address, or order number. AiPrise stores this alongside the verification so you can match results back to your records.
actions.search_businesses.description: Searches public business registries by name and country, returning a list of matching companies with their entity IDs, types, and addresses. Useful for looking up a business before creating a profile or running a verification.
actions.search_businesses.props.country_: 2-letter ISO country code where the business is registered (e.g. US, GB).
actions.search_businesses.props.name.des: The business name to search for. Partial matches are supported by AiPrise.
actions.search_businesses.props.state_co: Optional state or province code to narrow the search (e.g. CA, NY for the US). Leave empty to search the whole country.
actions.update_verification_result.descr: Manually changes the outcome of an identity check — useful when a human reviewer needs to approve or decline a case that AiPrise flagged for manual review.
actions.update_verification_result.props: The outcome you want to set. Choose **Approved** to pass the person, **Declined** to reject them, or **Pending** to put the case back into manual review.

The ID of the verification whose decision you want to change. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.
auth.description:
To get your AiPrise API key:
1. Log in to your [AiPrise dashboard](https://app.aiprise.com)
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**
3. Copy your API key and paste it here
auth.props.environment.description: Select the AiPrise environment to use
description: KYC, KYB, and fraud prevention platform — verify user identities, onboard businesses, run AML/sanctions checks, and detect fraud signals.
